WebKit (operator PC, Playwright WebKit 2359): 93 routes × visitor + player-amy × 3 languages × 390 only = 558 renders, run twice in full (baseline 22:01Z–00:49Z, regrade1 01:05–02:49Z) + the S1/S2 cells again at the end (regrade3, 6 cells, 03:40Z). Long content: the seeded '[probe] uat-std' 40-message chat and long-name meet were live for the Chromium baseline; the shared probe sweeper (SWEEP-AGE-V3, 3 h) cancelled/removed them before the re-grades, so later runs measured the chat and meet@long without the long content. Cleanup proof: fixtures-cleanup.json (0 live meets, 0 participants, 0 messages).

LAW 7 could not be held: other lanes deployed the app 14+ times and the engine once during the measurement (bundles afd5e999 → … → 9f75f736; engine 5fe81c2468 → d03605bb5d). Every cell records its bundle; a flip on a newer build is reported as changed-on-newer-build, not FLAKY. 'Closed during the run' lists families the first run saw that the latest no longer shows — closed by other lanes, not re-verified by their owners.

Instrument limits: controls are found by selector + .is-tap + outermost cursor:pointer (a Taro View with onClick and none of these is invisible to 5B/5C); English-on-zh is a heuristic (13 families re-classed 'probe' after reading the matches — user/sample data, see overrides.json); name detection is by class name; the header signature is a heuristic over the top band.
